Game Overview

Maxoo is a monster title where navigate a treacherous 2D world in Maxoo, collecting elusive silver keys while evading bouncing balls, robots, and pins. Test your dexterity with precise controls and double jumps across escalating challenges in eight levels of intense action, all while racing against the clock to find exits.
